_about: Hand-filled history for the ESPN years, which can't be pulled from anywhere. 2019 and later come from the data pipeline automatically. Put a person id (see people.json) for each season you know; leave null for unknown. 'notes' is free text shown on that season's card. 'asterisks' puts a * on that season's trophy, with the reason. 'silverStars' are honours short of a title (any season), shown as a silver star on the avatar.
